method: The full-resolution direct-Rumsey scan was opened in QGIS and its engraved coordinate labels were read directly. Four meridians and two parallels were followed through the scan, and all eight crossings were measured independently on full-resolution crops. Linen folds, the map frame, neatlines, shoreline strokes and geological hatching were excluded before the two corner checks were withheld.
qa_review: The top labels read 60d45mW, 60d40mW, 60d35mW and 60d30mW from west to east. The left frame labels read 47d05mN and 47d00mN from north to south. A full-resolution 4 by 2 contact sheet confirms every retained cross is on the thin engraved graticule; the heavier frame, doubled neatline and vertical linen folds are visibly separate.
